status: post-hoc mechanistic diagnostic motivated by the frozen direct-bridge directional results
purpose: Determine whether the strong source-target asymmetry in the direct bridge reflects a content/order x temporal-position interaction rather than a simple additive temporal-position effect.
data_source: Existing Replication A 3x3 intervention matrices only; no new policy inference.

factorial_cells.Y_AA: content/order row A with temporal positions A
factorial_cells.Y_AB: content/order row A with temporal positions B
factorial_cells.Y_BA: content/order row B with temporal positions A
factorial_cells.Y_BB: content/order row B with temporal positions B

primary_diagnostics: interaction L2 norm divided by native_pair_residual L2 norm
interaction L2 norm divided by mean L2 magnitude of the two row-specific temporal effects
algebraic_check: temporal_main_effect + content_order_main_effect must equal native_pair_residual within numerical tolerance
process_handling: Compute all diagnostics independently in P1/P2/P3, then average the three nuisance-process values for each episode x unordered pair.

interpretation.row_temporal_cosine_near_one: approximately additive temporal effect across content/order rows
interpretation.row_temporal_cosine_near_zero_or_negativ: strong content/order dependence or reversal of the temporal effect
interpretation.large_interaction_ratio: temporal sensitivity depends strongly on which matched content/order layout is present
interpretation.scope: mechanistic action-chunk diagnostic only; no behavioral claim
